response.sql: WITH counts_by_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT fundflux, record_count, SUM(record_count) OVER () as total_count, AVG(CAST(record_count AS FLOAT)) OVER () as avg_count FROM counts_by_source) SELECT fundflux, record_count as count, CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / total_count as share, record_count - avg_count as exceeds_average FROM stats WHERE record_count > avg_count ORDER BY count DESC;
